notable_claims: Universities providing Usenet access may be legally responsible for the content posted by their users under English law.
Suing universities for user-generated content is viewed by some as an attack on academic freedom and a catalyst for restricting network access.
classification.summary: A debate between L. Godfrey and Tim Klassen regarding the legality and ethics of suing universities for libelous content posted by their users on Usenet. Godfrey argues that universities are responsible for the publications they facilitate via computer accounts, while Klassen contends that such lawsuits threaten academic freedom by making institutions liable for members' opinions.
classification.title: Re: Laurence and Libel
